# HiLo3 (supplementary, unpublished) {#sec-hilo3}

{{< include _caution.qmd >}}

::: {.callout-caution}
## Unpublished data: local only
HiLo3 is an unpublished Fernald/Marchman lab study shared with us by Virginia Marchman. It is not
in Peekbank. This chapter reads the raw iChart file from the gitignored `cache/hilo3/`, and its
rendered output and derived data are gitignored too, so nothing from it is pushed until the lab
agrees to share it. Without the raw files the chapter renders only this note.
:::

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
i_am("notebooks/06-hilo3.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make notebooks/ the root
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))

RAW <- here("cache", "hilo3", "HiLo3AB30mn55cln.txt")
HAVE_DATA <- file.exists(RAW)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = HAVE_DATA)
```

## Design

Each child is taught two novel words (dofa, taju) at about 30 months, in one of three
between-subjects groups: 3, 6 or 9 teaching trials per word at visit A. A teaching trial shows one
novel object alone with one labeling sentence ("Here's a dofa."). Tests pair the two novel objects
("Where's the taju?").

| Phase | When | Teaching before it (3 / 6 / 9 groups) |
|---|---|---|
| TestA | visit A, after all teaching | 3 / 6 / 9 |
| Retention | visit B (within a week), before any re-teaching | 3 / 6 / 9 |
| TestB | visit B, after 1 refresh trial per word | 4 / 7 / 10 |

An offline picture-pointing test (3 per word per visit, not in the gaze data) runs after the
visit-A session and in the middle of visit B. Exposure counts below come from the teaching trials in
the gaze file, using the same rules as @sec-exposure.

## Trials

The iChart file has one row per trial, with gaze coded every 33 ms and the word onset at frame 29.
Codes: `1` = target, `0` = distractor; `.` and `-` = neither; blank = no frame recorded.

```{r}
#| label: read
raw <- read_tsv(RAW, col_types = cols(.default = "c"), name_repair = "unique_quiet") |>
  filter(!is.na(Sub.Num), Sub.Num != "")

frame_cols <- names(raw)[26:174]
stopifnot(names(raw)[54] == "F0", length(frame_cols) == 149)

trials <- raw |>
  transmute(row = row_number(),
            subject_id = paste0("hilo3_", Sub.Num),
            visit = Visit, age = as.numeric(Months), group = Group, order = Order,
            order_num = str_extract(Order, "[12](?=-?[AB]$)"),
            trial_order = as.integer(`Tr Num`), phase = Condition,
            condition_orig = ConditionOrig, target_image = `Target Image`,
            excluded = `PSO?` %in% "1") |>
  mutate(
    object = str_extract(target_image, "cubes|rings"),
    # refresh trials are not labeled with the word in ConditionOrig; order 1 pairs dofa with
    # the cubes, order 2 with the rings
    word = coalesce(str_extract(condition_orig, "dofa|taju"),
                    if_else((order_num == "1") == (object == "cubes"), "dofa", "taju")),
    exposure_type = case_when(phase %in% c("Exposure", "Refresh") ~ "teaching",
                              phase %in% c("TestA", "Retention", "TestB") ~ "test"),
    session = if_else(visit == "A", 1L, 2L))

trials |> count(group, visit, phase) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

## Exposure counts

```{r}
#| label: counts
events <- trials |> filter(!is.na(exposure_type)) |>
  select(subject_id, session, ev_order = trial_order, word, exposure_type)

tests <- trials |> filter(exposure_type == "test")

prior <- tests |>
  select(row, subject_id, session, trial_order, word) |>
  inner_join(events, by = c("subject_id", "word"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  rename(ev_session = session.y, session = session.x) |>
  mutate(when = case_when(ev_session == session & ev_order < trial_order ~ "session",
                          ev_session < session ~ "prev")) |>
  filter(!is.na(when)) |>
  summarise(teaching_session = sum(exposure_type == "teaching" & when == "session"),
            teaching_prev = sum(exposure_type == "teaching" & when == "prev"),
            test_session = sum(exposure_type == "test" & when == "session"),
            trials_since_teaching = suppressWarnings(min(
              (trial_order - ev_order)[exposure_type == "teaching" & when == "session"])),
            .by = row) |>
  mutate(trials_since_teaching = if_else(is.finite(trials_since_teaching),
                                         trials_since_teaching, NA_real_))

session_length <- trials |>
  summarise(session_trials = max(trial_order), .by = c(subject_id, session))

tests <- tests |>
  left_join(prior, by = "row") |>
  mutate(across(c(teaching_session, teaching_prev, test_session), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)),
         teaching = teaching_session + teaching_prev) |>
  left_join(session_length, by = c("subject_id", "session"))

tests |> count(group, phase, teaching) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

## Accuracy

As in @sec-trials: proportion of target looking 200–4000 ms after word onset among looks to target
or distractor. Trials with less than 50% valid data, or prescreened out by the lab (`PSO?`, treated
like Peekbank's `excluded`), are dropped. Blank frames (nothing recorded) do not count against a trial.

```{r}
#| label: accuracy
acc <- raw |>
  mutate(row = row_number()) |>
  filter(row %in% tests$row) |>
  select(row, all_of(frame_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "col", values_to = "code") |>
  mutate(t = (row_number() - 29) * 1000 / 30, .by = row) |>
  filter(t > 200, t <= 4000, !is.na(code)) |>
  mutate(correct = case_when(code == "1" ~ 1, code == "0" ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
  summarise(long_window_accuracy = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
            long_window_prop_data = mean(!is.na(correct)), .by = row)

hilo3 <- tests |>
  left_join(acc, by = "row") |>
  mutate(long_window_accuracy = if_else(long_window_prop_data >= .5 & !is.nan(long_window_accuracy),
                                        long_window_accuracy, NA))

hilo3 |>
  summarise(n_trials = n(), prescreened_out = sum(excluded),
            under_50pct_data = sum(!excluded & is.na(long_window_accuracy)),
            kept = sum(!excluded & !is.na(long_window_accuracy)), .by = phase)

hilo3 <- hilo3 |>
  filter(!excluded, !is.na(long_window_accuracy)) |>
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, c("TestA", "Retention", "TestB")),
         dataset_name = "hilo3", target_label = word)

write_csv(hilo3, here("cache", "hilo3", "hilo3_trials.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hilo3
#| fig-cap: "HiLo3: accuracy by teaching exposures before the test, for each test phase. Points are means across children (±95% CI); dashed line is chance."
#| fig-height: 3.5
hilo3 |>
  summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(subject_id, group, phase, teaching)) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), ci = 1.96 * sd(acc) / sqrt(n),
            .by = c(phase, teaching)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = teaching, y = mean)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci)) +
  facet_wrap(~phase, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10)) +
  labs(x = "Teaching exposures before test", y = "Proportion target looking")
```

The TestB drop is concentrated in the order-1 lists:

```{r}
#| label: order
hilo3 |>
  summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(subject_id, order_num, phase)) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(acc), n_children = n(), .by = c(phase, order_num)) |>
  arrange(phase, order_num)
```

## Model

Teaching varies between children (group) and, by one refresh trial, between phases. The age range
is too narrow (28–31 months) for an age term.

```{r}
#| label: hilo3-model
hilo3 <- hilo3 |> mutate(log_teaching = log(teaching + 1))

m_hilo3 <- lmer(long_window_accuracy ~ log_teaching + phase + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | target_label),
                data = hilo3)
m_hilo3_testA <- lmer(long_window_accuracy ~ log_teaching + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | target_label),
                      data = hilo3 |> filter(phase == "TestA"))

bind_rows(all_phases = tidy(m_hilo3, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE),
          testA_only = tidy(m_hilo3_testA, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE),
          .id = "model") |>
  select(model, term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
```

## Added to the Peekbank model

HiLo3 as an eighth dataset in the dataset-slopes model of @sec-slopes (12–36 months, N–N tests).

```{r}
#| label: combined
library(brms)

nn_hilo3 <- read_csv(here("data", "derived", "novel_trials.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(role == "test_nn", age >= 12, age <= 36, !is.na(teaching)) |>
  mutate(subject_id = as.character(subject_id)) |>
  bind_rows(hilo3 |> select(dataset_name, subject_id, target_label, age, teaching,
                            long_window_accuracy)) |>
  mutate(log_teaching = log(teaching + 1), log_age = log(age / 24))

m_slopes <- readRDS(here("cache", "05_brms_slopes.rds"))
m_slopes_hilo3 <- update(m_slopes, newdata = nn_hilo3, seed = 2026,
                         file = here("cache", "hilo3", "06_brms_slopes_hilo3"),
                         file_refit = "on_change")

bind_rows(peekbank = as_tibble(fixef(m_slopes), rownames = "term"),
          peekbank_plus_hilo3 = as_tibble(fixef(m_slopes_hilo3), rownames = "term"),
          .id = "model") |>
  filter(term != "Intercept")
```
